scope: Code & Tell adaptations of latest Signal rail and Open field; zero projects before, first presentations during; ballot not open.

prompts.prompt:
Adapt the attached HackJudge homepage concept into a CODE & TELL event-mode homepage while preserving its Engineered typography, recognizable platform identity and palette. A wide landscape board with TWO equal desktop views, left "Before the session · Zero projects", right "During the session · First presentations". Board caption "Code & Tell concept · Sample event details". Both focal event title "Code & Tell" in broad squared geometric lettering, secondary "Fresh ideas", sample date November 9, 2026, Innovation Center. Purpose "Show what you built. Share what you learned." Header HackJudge / Events / Sign in. Before View event and How to participate actions; during View event. Teal remains shared primary, COBALT is the restrained event-specific accent instead of hackathon gold. SAME neutral/teal base as source, no wholesale branding change by event mode. No photos, abstract artwork, projects or fake presenters before event. Critical: Code & Tell is a session with a ranked audience ballot, NOT expert rubric judging, hackathon build tracks, or appreciation hearts. DELETE ALL hackathon content: challenges, Energy/climate etc tracks, Innovation/Impact/Execution, Build, Submit deadline, all judging language. Session agenda illustrative: 17:00 Welcome, 17:15 Short demos, 18:00 Audience ballot, 18:15 Wrap-up. Before useful content 'Present' with 'Show the work, explain one decision, share what you learned.' and 'Join in' with 'Watch the demos, ask questions, choose your favorites when voting opens.' No project counts or placeholder gallery. During Short demos highlighted in agenda, state Session underway, exactly TWO plain project entries Voltify / Community energy-demand forecasting and AgriSense / Field sensors and crop insights, no team names or media, under heading 'What’s being shared'. Label sequence 'Presentation order, not rankings'; no fake results or votes, selected rankings or submitted ballots. Status 'Voting opens at 18:00', no live vote button because ballot hasn't opened. A plain explanation 'When voting opens, rank your favorites and save your ballot.' is acceptable, no invented max count. No message 'Judging opens after submissions close' ANYWHERE. Bottom secondary upcoming calendar CivicHacks / Dec 5, Community showcase / Dec 12, All events. Readable actual website UI. This is still homepage next-event experience not a deep judging page. Task-specific content/layout should be distinctly Code & Tell, familiar controls consistent with Hackathon. Preserve zero-project completeness without needing extra team data.
